title: osmo_refdb-hpc pipeline parameters
description: osmo_refdb canonical build, catalog, BacDive and NaCl model on SLURM + Apptainer. Documents the parameters; not enforced (no nf-schema plugin).

outdir.description: The release folder (absolute path, shared storage); with -entry profile_samples, where the profiles go

release.description: The release's name (e.g. v10), written into its PROVENANCE.json, catalog and NaCl model

catalog_genes.description: Where the GMGC gene file goes or is: <dir>/GMGC10.human-gut.95nr.0.5.percent.prevalence.fna.gz (absolute)

db.description: -entry profile_samples: the release folder to profile with

markers_file.description: The marker genes for the release's markers/ (default markers.yaml)

families_file.description: The families to build (default: families.yaml in the pipeline)

publish_dir_mode.description: How results are published (Nextflow publishDir mode)

catalog_source.description: Free-text source recorded in the catalog
catalog_source.default: GMGC v1.0 human gut, prevalence > 0.5% (Ducarmon et al., Cayman)

catalog_source_url.description: Source URL recorded in the catalog

catalog_force.description: Rebuild the catalog annotation even if it exists

nchunks.description: Tasks per per-genome step (BacDive proteins, BacDive annotation)

split_mode.description: Calibration/test split of the release build

read_lengths.description: Also simulate the test reads at these exact lengths (wgsim), e.g. '100,150,250,300'; scored per length in results/metrics/summary_by_read_length.tsv

background_r1.description: R1 of a real metagenome with no known osmoadaptation genes, scored as background in the test benchmark (results/metrics/background_fpr.tsv); with --background_r2

diamond_min_subject_cover.description: The read benchmark's osmotool profile --min_subject_cover (0: off, osmotool's default)

min_eval_positives.description: Report levels, profile and annotate: the distinct positive calibration sequences a reporting unit needs before the rule decides on it; below it the unit is none with reason insufficient_evidence (0: off)

refs_store.description: Keep the UniProt fetch here, per family (<UniProt release>/families/<family>_<key>) and for the fusion pairs and HMM decoys (<UniProt release>/shared/<families file>_<key>), and reuse it in later builds in the same UniProt release: an edited family refetches only itself. Unset: every build fetches.

random_background_n.description: Proteins in the benchmark's random bacterial background (REFS_BACKGROUND)

queue.description: SLURM partition (default profile only); empty = the cluster's default

slurm_extra.description: Extra sbatch options, e.g. '--account=myproject' (default profile only)

work_dir.description: Nextflow's work directory; empty = ./work (use scratch if launching from $HOME)

custom_config_version.description: Commit of nf-core/configs the institutional profiles come from

custom_config_base.description: Base URL or local clone of nf-core/configs

bacdive_options.title: BacDive
bacdive_options.description: The BacDive phenotype analysis, on the finished release

bacdive_full.description: The full BacDive set, the salt-in control and the NaCl model; default: the pilot strains only

bacdive_pilot.description: The strain table of the default BacDive run (columns of assets/bacdive/pilot_strains.tsv); default: the 43 pilot strains

bacdive_snapshot.description: Harvested BacDive batches to start from (bacdive_raw/), to reproduce that table (--bacdive_full)

validation_options.title: Real-genome validation
validation_options.description: The real-genome checks, on the finished release

reference_genomes_dir.description: osmotool's test_genomes/ (the reference genomes, *.fna), for the system calls; unset: that check is skipped

test_genomes_dir.description: Genomes with curated target genes; default: assets/test_genomes

recall_read_pairs.description: Simulated read pairs per genome for the read recall check
